extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the BZX84C3V3 row was selected from the BZX84C2V4 through BZX84C75 electrical-characteristics table for manufacturer hongjiacheng.
The supplied PDF identity was verified as LCSC C19077467, MPN BZX84C3V3, manufacturer hongjiacheng, with SHA-256 39b6ea9e2fb90c0f556434867115de516305a365515113676b906ff1ade79e83.
Zener reverse semantics are preserved: nominal VZ = 3.3 V is paired with the tabulated reverse test current IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT = 95 ohm is at IZT and maximum ZZK = 600 ohm is at IZK = 1 mA.

The BZX84C3V3 electrical-characteristics row gives inclusive VZ bounds of 3.1 V minimum and 3.5 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA, maximum reverse leakage IR = 5 microA at VR = 1.0 V, and admissible IZM = 5 mA, with TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.

The p. 3 Fig. 1 zener-characteristics plot labels traces for selected series voltages including 2.4 V and 4.7 V, but does not provide an individually identified BZX84C3V3 trace; no target-specific curve points were extracted.

No component-specific capacitance or reverse-recovery-time specification is published in the supplied datasheet. The p. 3 capacitance and dynamic-impedance plots are family-level typical characteristics without a uniquely identified BZX84C3V3 trace and were not assigned component-specific points.
Maximum ratings include PD = 300 mW and forward voltage VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA on p. 1; junction and storage temperature limits are -55 to +150 degC and typical RthetaJ-A is 417 degC/W.
omission_reason: No target-specific usable curve was extracted: the datasheet plots are shared series-level characteristics, and the BZX84C3V3 trace is not individually identified with unambiguous numeric points.
